title: Avatar data contracts (params + consent) + validator + v1 roster data
summary: The non-biometric data contracts the avatar system is built on: data/schemas/avatar/avatar_params (cosmetic parameter set on the shared rig; no biometric data) + consent_record (layered opt-in), with a reference validator (validate_avatar) + forbidden-key privacy guard + tests. Plus the canonical v1 preset roster built on the contract: data/avatar/roster/ (8 curated avatar_params + manifest), the Brain-B/data half of M1-AVAT-01. The on-device C# runtime mirrors the validator; the Unity selection UI loads the roster data.
deliverables: data/avatar/roster/ (8 preset avatar_params + roster.json manifest + README)

acceptance_tests.test: avatar_params + consent_record schemas are valid JSON Schema, closed, non-biometric (no media/landmark/template fields), with valid/invalid fixtures and the forbidden-key guard; tests green.

The 8 v1 roster presets (data/avatar/roster/) are schema-valid avatar_params (rig-conformant by construction, non-biometric) and satisfy the AUTH #024 inclusive casting matrix (body/gender/skin-tone/age spread, >=6 floor) with distinct CVD-safe hero colors; manifest and files agree; tests green.

auth_required.what: roster composition implements the #024 casting spec

history.event: built + merged under AUTH #044: data/schemas/avatar (schemas + validate_avatar + 7 tests + fixtures). AT-1 met. in-progress: the C# mirror + SPEC/DESIGN_SYSTEM reconcile remain.

added the canonical v1 preset roster data (data/avatar/roster/: 8 avatar_params + manifest + README + test) on the contract, implementing the #024 casting matrix; AT-2 met. Scope broadened to include the roster data. Still in-progress for the C# mirror.

notes: Non-biometric by construction. The C# runtime (M1-AVAT-02) mirrors validate_avatar.forbidden_keys. The roster data (data/avatar/roster/) feeds the Unity selection UI (M1-AVAT-01); final art/names are gj-design's, hero colors are a CVD-safe (Okabe-Ito) readability basis.
